integrity: An analytic proof handles arbitrary real offsets and repeated windows. Exact-rational finite tests are supplementary and are not substituted for infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The exact identity applies only to unit-height triangular splines on the integer time-frequency lattice with equally weighted full modulation/translation channels. Equispaced optimality was already implied by the classical circle polarization theorem. New quantitative defect and multiplicity-sensitive equality structure is supported by a full analytic proof and finite exact rational checks but is not independently audited; equivalent older formula cannot be excluded.
title: An exact positive cubic-gap defect for multiwindow hat-spline Gabor frames
